items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: the band I was in, was just the one Joe Williams came into.

ctx.x: [laughs] Talk about if you like, about playing on Basie’s band.

Well, I never played in Woody's [Herman] band, that band that I thought was so wonderful, I'm sure it might have been a similar experience in the sense that, usually when you’d hear bands and you like the way they sounded, when you got inside and started playing with them it started falling apart because it never felt like it felt when you were in it like it sounded when you're outside of it. And Basie is the only band that ever felt like it when you were in there. I mean we just couldn't wait to get to work…
Was Gus Johnson with Basie when you were there?
